contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

evidenceContentIds.description: Content ids of the known evidence (bounded by the producer; an open continuation reference may be carried as an unknown field).

items.description: sha-256 content address (64 lowercase hex). Normative derivation: the frozen AISE-CONTENT-V1 canonical encoding (see apps/android ContentIdentity).

gaps.description: Knowledge gaps that ground next-action recommendations.

gapId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

kind.description: MISSING | WEAK | AMBIGUOUS — the canonical gap-kind vocabulary of @aise/shared-contracts; a gap is a fact about what is NOT known, never absence.

subjectKind.description: Open vocabulary (lower_snake_case) naming the subject this summary covers (e.g. `task`, `project`, `engineering_case`).

subjectRef.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

summarizedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.

totalItems.description: Total known evidence items for the subject.
